thread:
maria-support: FYI — Luma Robotics just escalated: they got charged twice for the same subscription renewal. Customer says one charge came from a PO flow and one from a saved card. invoice IDs: INV-2024-1192, INV-2024-1193. Can billing triage?

andrew-billing: Ack. I can see both invoices are for the same period and same customer_id (cust_9x7). One was created at 2024-04-12T09:52:14Z, the other 2024-04-12T09:52:22Z. Looks like two payment methods cleared.

olivia-support: Customer says they submitted a PO first and then a dev on their side manually charged the card because the UI said pending. They want a reversal for the card charge and a single invoice reflecting PO. Is there a quick refund path?

andrew-billing: We can issue a refund for card invoice (INV-2024-1193) once we confirm it was duplicate. Before refunding, need to confirm there wasn't a partial application to the PO. Pulling payment ledger...

luis-qa: Quick check: I pulled webhook logs from the payments queue. I see delivery A: webhook to payments service for PO confirmation succeeded at 09:52:13, then delivery B: card-charge handler triggered at 09:52:21. The webhook consumer has a fallback/requeue path that will re-run reconciliation if the initial flow didn't mark order as paid. Looks like the PO flow and card flow overlapped.

sre-bot: Attached log excerpt from prod-payments (fmt: [ts] component message):
```
[2024-04-12T09:52:13.123Z] payments.po-handler INFO received PO: external_id=PO-2041 order_hash=abc123
[2024-04-12T09:52:13.456Z] payments.reconcile INFO reconcile(order_hash=abc123) -> status: pending -> mark: paid_by_po
[2024-04-12T09:52:21.789Z] payments.card-handler INFO processing saved_card for cust_9x7 order_hash=abc123 idempotency_key=null
[2024-04-12T09:52:21.790Z] payments.card-handler ERROR conflict: order already marked paid_by_po
[2024-04-12T09:52:21.800Z] payments.card-handler INFO forcing charge due to no idempotency key -> created payment PAY-3321
```

maria-support: That ERROR + forcing charge bit is the smoking gun. Why is the card handler forcing a charge if it sees conflict?

tom-eng: The current logic was implemented to tolerate race conditions: if reconcile finds paid but the card handler has no idempotency key it will attempt a fallback charge to avoid leaving customers unpaid. That worked pre-PO flows but that fallback shouldn't kick in when paid_by_po. Looks like we missed a check for payment method precedence.

andrew-billing: For refund: we should refund the card payment (PAY-3321) in full and apply a note to the PO invoice to indicate payment captured. I'll start the refund and set refund_reason=duplicate_charge_po. Finance must approve reversal because this is a captured card.

finance-ops: Approving manual refund for PAY-3321. Please include customer authorization note and confirm refund id once processed. Also confirm whether we need a credit note for tax reporting.

olivia-support: I messaged the customer to apologize and asked for permission to refund the card charge and consolidate invoices. They approved.

luis-qa: Repro steps for engineering: 
1) Trigger PO webhook (payload below)
2) Simultaneously trigger card charge via saved card flow without idempotency key
3) Observe race where reconcile marks paid_by_po then card-handler falls back and creates payment

Example webhook payload: 
```
{
  "event": "po.approved",
  "external_id": "PO-2041",
  "order_hash": "abc123",
  "customer_id": "cust_9x7",
  "amount": 120000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "timestamp": "2024-04-12T09:52:13Z"
}
```

Suggested quick fix: enforce idempotency at the order_hash level in card-handler and add a paid_status check that aborts fallback charge if paid_by_po or paid_offline. Also log the reconciliation source.

tom-eng: I can push a small patch to the card-handler: if order.status in ("paid_by_po","paid_offline","paid") then return 409 and do NOT create payment when idempotency_key==null. Also add metrics for fallback attempts. Can do PR + canary to prod-payments.

andrew-billing: After patch lands, we should reconcile the two invoices: refund INV-2024-1193 (card) and mark INV-2024-1192 (PO) as paid, then issue credit note if tax system requires it. I'll open the accounting ticket.

finance-ops: Ticket FIN-2024-598 opened for the reversal and tax follow-up. Refund transaction id will be REF-98421 once processed.

maria-support: Outcome update for the customer thread: refunded card charge (REF-98421) processed at 2024-04-12T10:02:05Z, PO invoice remains as single invoice for the period. Customer confirmed receipt of refund.

tom-eng: Deployed patch to prod-payments canary at 2024-04-12T12:18Z. Observed no repeat duplicate charges in canary traffic. Rolling out to 80% now.

luis-qa: Added end-to-end test in payments-integration: simulate simultaneous PO + card flows and assert only one payment created. Test added in PR #4210.

olivia-support: Closing customer loop. They're happy and asked if we can add a short note to the invoice PDF explaining PO applied. QOL request forwarded to product. :sparkles: 

maria-support: Thanks team. Action items: 1) tom -> merge + full rollout (in progress), 2) andrew -> complete accounting entries and credit note if needed, 3) luis -> monitor for 24h, 4) product -> follow-up on invoice PDF note. I'll update the internal incident tracker.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-381 (duplicate charge from webhook race). Severity: P2.

maria-support: Marking thread resolved for support. Will reopen if any regressions reported.
